next.reason: Both forbid INITIATE of a report already initiated and not terminated; 1985 states no result for a violation. 2023 §2023:14.9.21.4 GR2: 'An INITIATE statement shall not be executed if report-name-1 is in the active state. If it is in the active state, the EC-REPORT-ACTIVE exception condition is set to exist and the execution of the INITIATE statement has no other effect'; §2023:14.9.21.4 GR4 makes INITIATE set the active state, and the report section prose §2023:13.8.4 (no catalog rule) ends it at TERMINATE. Undefined run-time result became a defined exception condition.
